limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

projects-desktop-dark.png.task: Scan grouped projects, workspace actions and open conversations with stable selection.
projects-desktop-dark.png.observations: Project status strips and Open workspace actions share one row, so conversations sit closer to their project heading. The compact browser begins directly below the application bar; both project columns and action targets fit with readable labels. Branch rules attach consistently to the conversation rows, count and disclosure controls remain separate, and neither appearance clips content.
